R813.note: Build FAIL: fileHeader is now declared and never used, so the package does not compile; the extension-from-detected-type mapping is the right shape and is stated, but the handler is dead as shipped.

R814.note: Dropping the ignoringRequestMatchers exemption restores Spring Security's default CSRF filter for the PATCH route; authentication rule and all other behaviour untouched.

R815.note: FileName stays cmd.exe, and .NET only quotes an ArgumentList entry containing whitespace or a quote, so a host like 127.0.0.1&whoami is pasted unquoted into the /c command line and cmd still splits on &; the fix should invoke ping.exe directly.

R816.note: Swaps the Origin-only check for net/http.CrossOriginProtection.Check, the framework-native control; the zero value is usable and the only behaviour delta is that non-browser callers sending neither Sec-Fetch-Site nor Origin now pass, which blocks no legitimate use.

R817.note: CGI::escapeHTML works when called as a plain function (self_or_default supplies the default object) and closes both the reported note sink and the ticket_id sink, which the write-up states.

R818.note: Removing the SignatureValidator delegate restores JsonWebTokenHandler's real signature check; the added ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true is already the default and is disclosed as such.

R819.note: The overread is out of the 64-byte unterminated line buffer, not out of the 256-byte destination, so %255s still lets sscanf run ~190 bytes past line on the exact input the case describes; nothing else changes for valid input.

R820.note: Host allowlist blocks http://evil.com but isRedirectAllowed returns true whenever scheme is null, so a protocol-relative //evil.com/path still reaches sendRedirect - the write-up wrongly calls scheme-less URIs inherently safe; rejection path only affects untrusted targets.

R821.note: Key source moves from the token's jku to a hardcoded JWKS URL, closing the vector, but ValidAlgorithms is narrowed to RS256 only, which rejects a legitimately signed RS512/ES256 token, and the JWKS fetch in a static initializer turns a transient fetch failure into a permanent TypeInitializationException.

R822.note: Appending File.separator to the prefix closes the /app/uploads-secret sibling bypass; every path genuinely under the base directory still resolves and the 403/404 paths are unchanged.

R823.note: math.evaluate replaces eval with a maintained arithmetic parser, closing code injection; the added try/catch turning a parse error into a 400 is stated and legitimate arithmetic still evaluates.

R824.note: Rejects negative offset while still signed and re-expresses the length test as length > packet_len - offset, removing both the sign wrap and the addition overflow; valid windows still copy length bytes and return length.

R825.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption from /api/** to the documented /api/webhooks/** only; authorization rules and the webhook path's token-free access are left exactly as before.

R826.note: Sort is checked against a fixed allowlist before interpolation, closing the ORDER BY injection while AccountId/Query stay bound and the created_at default still works; the ArgumentException surfaces as an unhandled 500 rather than a 400 for an unsupported sort.

R827.note: Adds the getSessionIdentifier callback csrf-csrf v4 needs, binding tokens to req.session.userId; requireSession runs before both mint and verify so the identifier is always populated and no legitimate flow changes.
